tips: | Aatrox is very strong early game, especially if it's a good Aatrox that knows how to control spacing in lane. However you easily outscale him especially if you run Ignite. One thing to be wary of is that, Aatrox R fears ghouls and maiden, and that can remove a lot of your damage temporarily. Also you should try placing W down after he dashes with E.

| Akali is a decent matchup, having a lot of strong burst in her kit. She has really good survivability with the E and the dumb W. However once you hit your one item powerspike, and you hit your E, you should be able to beat her reasonably, unless she outplays you.

| Skill matchup. If she ever E's remember it's a linear skill that goes in a straight line and it's also her only dash, meaning you can W yourself to trap her/Q her mid stun-animation of her E, or E her, as your E is uninterruptible and you can abuse the cast time (or do all of it if you're an insane player.)

| Cho Gath is a pretty rough matchup, as you have to go for a very rough all in to kill him, as you cannot poke him, because he can sustain off the ghouls with his passive. He can also R your maiden, so don't just randomly throw it out, as he will take a free snack. Just play and look around for opportunities with your jungler.

| Darius is a very easy matchup for Yorick, reason being that as long as you land your skills, E and W with ghouls, you should be able to beat him at all times, and it being an even easier time with ult. However be wary that if you make a stupid mistake, e.g. getting caught out by him in a long lane with no ghouls, or walking into him with no ghouls or doing anything related to him with no ghouls.
| Easy matchup because he's immobile and also you can buy grevious wounds, and he doesn't really have any answer to your W.

| Fiora is a hard matchup for Yorick, being mobile and having a generally very powerful all-in with her ult. Hug a wall so that she can't proc the fourth vital, use your W only after she very recently used Q, and also always respond with a Q trade if she goes for a Q too. Oh and avoid the vitals.
| Be wary as he has very powerful poke in the early levels. Easy to all-in however, due to the fact that he is immobile and has generally low attack speed.
| No mobility, but is quite tanky with his W. Easy matchup as long as you land your E and W, and kite in and out when he E's. Don't get hit by his Q.

| Very annoying matchup. Has lots of poke and damage. I highly suggest the omnistone page against him, and hoping to get a good keystone against him. Avoid the walls due to his mega form R. Respect him when he's about to transform with E.
| Walk away when he W's and respect him. Don't walk directly in his face, or he'll just E you. After he E's however, Unleash Hell upon him.

| Yorick beats Hecarim easily with 4 grave setup and Conqueror, and wins even harder with Maiden. Go normal Hullbreaker build, and go Divine Sunderer if you're struggling in the 1v1. Be wary that Hecarim can E out of your wall. Don't fight him when he has Q stacks, and save Q's till his W is over.
| Ranged annoying rat champ. Go doran's shield and try poking with E and ghouls. Build MR. build vamp scepter if you need to live. Outscale him. Dodge his E.
| illaoi useless without e. ghouls block her e lol.

| Irelia is a hard matchup early game. She can Q all your ghouls to heal up and to stack up her passive. Your wall is completely useless, as she can Q, and E is very hard to hit, because she can Q everything. And also even if you do hit the E, she'll just eat your ghouls up for breakfast. However, once you get hullbreaker you will be too tanky for her to fight, as Maiden and Q is too much brute damage for her to tank. The secret to winning this matchup is to run ignite, as it cuts down a lot of her power which is in the healing of Q.

| Jarvan does a surprisingly high amount of damage and has insanely good gank setup. Yorick has no effective way to dodge it, unless he has flash, and can thus be troublesome. But still, if you land your combo you'll beat him in most 1v1s.

| Pain. It's pain everywhere. He Q's you then E's and kills your maiden. Then your ghouls. It's a massacre. There's nothing you can do about it. Jax enters a defensive stance for 4 secon- | Press W on him when he jumps you, as he has no mobility for a while after that.

| This is a good matchup for Yorick if the Jayce is bad/intermediate. The reason being, he remains as an immobile ranged squishy champion that can't survive your burst effectively. Doran's shield + Second wind and stalling for level 3-5 engage is the play in this matchup.
| No range, no mobility, not enough damage early game. Outscales you, but you can oppress her early game. and use that lead to destroy her mid-game.
| rat ultimate that stuns everything and kills everything in existence, but he's immobile so kill him.

| Kled E is bugged and one shots all your ghouls, however, there's also this weird bug where Kled baby form counts towards his maximum HP. This means your E, R, Bork, and Divine Sunderer rips holes into him. Go Sunderer against Kled and make him miserable. Also he's full ad, meaning you can stack armor effectively.

| Full ad ranged insane high dps pain man. But you can manage much better than other top laners, as you have E and can choose when to engage. Also when you hit level 6, you can place down R, and he has to respect you.

| Malphite is a tank, and Yorick is a tank shredder, having percent health damage on his E and R. Malphite however, has a lot of consistent poke with his Q and can still be tanky due to his insanely high amount of armor.

| Maokai is a tank that Yorick smashes. However he has a lot of CC and with a spammable Q as well as a passive that heals him, it can take a lot of time to kill him. Stil good matchup as Yorick demolishes tanks.

| Mordekaiser's Death Realm removes ghouls and maiden, as it transports Yorick to a different place, making Yorick useless. However, Yorick can survive with smart W placement, and fighting him after ult is over.
| Dog that can stack on your ghouls, but who cares when he's literally immobile and has to eat all your damage.
| Immobile, but insanely annoying. Has the E that can go through ghouls and root you for 9 years, and has the ult that literally makes you have to walk away from her. Also the W. no comment on that.
| Olaf can run you down in a long lane so be very wary of that. But he has no mobility and is still heavily reliant on landing Q's. Use W smart and kite in and out with ghouls and R to kill him.
| High damage, and can break your cage with your E. But he's not tanky enough early game to deal with you, so it's still decent enough for both parties to have chance of killing each other.

| Pantheon is the ultimate early game brutaliser, being able to deal insane damage and have tankiness with the E. Play safe early game, and outscale at your sheen item. Don't Q him when he E's in your direction.
| Poppy can E Yorick on his cage, and also use E to get out of the cage and can therefore be a little annoying. However, she doesn't do enough damage to threaten Yorick so it's alright.
| Ad heavy champion. and has a bit of mobility with her E. Try to predict her E dash back with your W. Build early bramble/platecaps.
| Insane early game. High DPS, very mobile, and very beefy with healing from his Q. Play for scaling, and play for W's when he wastes both his dashes. Also full ad, so buying armor is a good idea.
| High damage yeah but he's got no mobility outside of bushes so when he does jump, put that box on his ass and whoop him.
| High mobility. High damage. But at the same time, she is limited by the own player's skill. If she ever Q3's, all in her. If she E's all in her. If she ults, run.
| No mobility, but does a lot of damage. Avoid walking into his R, and try to W after he W's, as he gets a lot of movement speed.
| No mobility mage. However he does do a lot of consistent damage, so try dodging his Q's. Most Ryzes also run phase rush, so try to box him before he can get it off.

| Disgusting molerat. Insane CC and damage. Can use ghouls as a way to stun you with E, so try to stay on the same side of your ghouls. Try to play safe and scale, playing for items. Sunderer is a must in this matchup.

| Shen is a rolling rat. He has high damage with insane tankiness, and the stupid ult that makes it so that he can win the game without even playing against you. You can use W to displace his ult teleport, but most of the time it's better to let him teleport so you can eat plates. Try dodging his E, and don't walk into Shen if the spirit blade goes through you, as he hurts very very hard when that happens.
| Immobile champion, low damage until he gets his items, and cannot escape your cage without flash. Perfect for Yorick.

| Very tanky, and does a surprisingly high amount of damage. You can use the side of your W to displace him, cancelling his Q. You can also place W you completely cancel his R. But he can also E your ghouls in return so uh be wary of that gank setup.

| No mobility, not enough damage to deal with you early game. Unleash reality, show him the truth. But his level 6 is quite scary as he heals of your ghouls and R, so be wary of that. Executioner's a good idea.

| Strong early game but you should outscale him as long as you build anti-healing with executioner's. He's currently bugged right now and cannot kill your ghouls with his empowered autoes, so this matchup is brutal for him. Try to go for aggressive Q's early on, as he's not that strong until he gets ability haste.

| Tahm Kench has mobility with W now, able to jump out of your cage. He's also incredibly tanky and does a lot of damage. His combo of Q and W is also undodgable, so try to dodge as many Q's as possible. Thankfully, Yorick can W him while his channeling W, so try to that as much as possible, although it is hard as you can't see him when he jumps into the ground, and Yorick has insane tank-killing.
| No mobility, no survivability. Don't Q if you're blinded, wait it out.
| No mobility, no survivability unless he R's. Play around your E W and ghouls. Be wary of his E capability with his jungler.

| Tryndamere has a low cooldown spammable E and Yorick has no CC to deal with him especially when he ults. The only way to win this matchup is to kill him 3 times before level 6 and to get a massive amount of armor and components of triforce, before he hits his powerspikes. Build Steelplates.

| Has a very powerful all-in, if you dodge his E but intentionally get by his Q, he is fightable. His W rips all your ghouls and wall very quickly, but getting hit by one of his abilities makes it so that the machine gun targets you instead of the ghouls, so that you can dps with him the ghouls.

| Vayne is a short-range champion, meaning you can land your E most of the time when she tries to poke you. Get cs safely, and go for an all-in when you have 4 graves up. Be careful when you all-in however, as she can E you on the Yorick cage.
| Vladimir is an easy matchup as he's immobile, and cannot avoid your E unless he pools, and cannot run out of your W.

| Volibear has no mobility except for his R, meaning you can put him in the box and beat him around with ghouls. Be wary of his E, if you get hit by that be ready to feel pain. Try kite in and out when he W's you. Try to avoid getting W'd two times in a row. It's a hard matchup which requires good spacing,

| Wukong can be a very rough matchup if you don't respect his damage. Levels 1-6 try to respond with Q's as much as possible but play safe, as he's much stronger than you with E attack speed steroid, conqueror and passive stacked. If he messes up a Q on a minion or W. Go for it.
| Sidestep his Q's. Very obnoxious because he can E around like a rat and dodge your skills. Play safe or aggressive, doesn't matter, just try Q'ing a lot if he tries to do anything spicy.

| Yone is very powerful after 2 items. However he is completely useless if you buy tabis and dodge his nados. Try sidestepping a lot to dodge his q's. Be careful as his E is very powerful and can do a lot more damage than expected

| Very annoying, as he has a lot of healing and cc, making him powerful with ganks. Also has a jump that can make him pretty much just leave any scenario he wants. One thing you should abuse in the matchup is the fact that your W displaces enemies, meaning you can W on the side of it to push him and to cancel his E.

| Gwen does percent health damage and specialises against immobile champions that cannot run away or evade her Q and R. Doesn't help that you will never get priority, due to her incredibly powerful early game which never gets outscaled. However she only has one dash, and your ghouls and Maiden can damage Gwen even in her W. Abuse that with your E.

| Right now, Udyr is incredibly overtuned, having high damage and strong tankiness. However, if you can land your combo he should be easy pickings due to his lack of dealing with ghouls and the cage efficiently.
| Very powerful champion with Yorick. Helps with 1v2's in the side Yorick faces, giving him a very powerful boost in health.
| Very powerful champion with Yorick. Finishes off champions and helps with 1v2's in the side that Yorick will face.

| Yuumi is good with every champion, however Yorick specialises in being in the side lane, and Yuumi sticking on him makes the entire team lose a champion which isn't good as you don't need 2 people split-pushing in the same lane.
| Yorick can place a wall down, and Vaynes can condemn them into the wall.
| Qiyana ult hits around walls, this also applies for Yorick walls, meaning you can do some pretty spicy stuff with it.
| Insanely broken with Yorick. Can synergise with the minions it spawns after getting herald, with maiden push to make an almost unbeatable push. If Bel'Veth gets baron, it's game over.
